key_findings: The non-cyclic sampler bug materially invalidated earlier residual-family-balanced training conclusions because it repeated early task-bucket rows.
With fixed code and cyclic coverage, the evidence_judgment_head path reaches the residual promotion threshold: 6/10.
The same run preserves protected strict gates: filtered strict 22/22 and old canary strict 23/23.
It is not promotable because validation regresses below the required thresholds: filtered validation 17/22 and old validation 18/23.
Bridge train fit improves from 9/61 in Stage11498 to 38/61 in Stage11503, but remains incomplete.

next_hypothesis.allowed_next_experiment: Run one controlled rerun from Stage11444 with fixed cyclic coverage, same manifest/scorer, but stronger preservation/validation replay or lower update budget. Promotion must keep residual >=6/10 and restore validation gates.
next_hypothesis.description: The evidence head can move residual under proper row coverage, but needs validation/canary preservation pressure or validation replay to avoid over-shifting F-like evidence roles.

selected_frontier_after_decision.reason: Stage11503 lifted residual and preserved strict, but failed validation gates.
